name: Agent Observatory
description: Results-first dashboard for every Paseo agent and subagent: unread queue, timelines, usage and token statistics, scheduled runs, optional AI reviews and turn summaries, plus alerts and scheduled sends. English and Simplified Chinese, plus user languages.

zh-CN.name: Agent 观测台
zh-CN.description: 所有 Paseo Agent 与子 Agent 的结果优先看板：未读队列、时间线、用量与 Token 统计、定时运行、可选的智能分析与每轮小结，以及提醒和定时发送。支持英文、简体中文和用户自定义语言。
